prompt_text: What is the best service to check if AI engines like ChatGPT recommend my small business?
ai_overview_text:
To check if ChatGPT and other AI answer engines recommend your small business, you can use dedicated AI Search Visibility and AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) tracking tools. eSEOspace +2
HubSpot AI Search Grader: A free tool that evaluates your brand across ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini, analyzing how each model characterizes your company based on training and web data. HubSpot
Otterly AI: A popular monitoring platform (starting around $29/month) that tracks brand visibility, mentions, average position, and website citations across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Claude, and Copilot. YouTube·Phil Pallen +1
BaaDigi AI Visibility Tool: A free interactive checker that lets you input your trade, city, and business name to run live queries against ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, and Perplexity to see top recommendations. BaaDigi
Radar Kit & Peak AI: Enterprise-to-agency grade tracking platforms designed for cross-border prompt position monitoring, share-of-voice calculations, and competitor benchmarking across major AI search engines. YouTube·GEO Mastery with Adam
Major SEO Suites (Semrush, Ahrefs, and SE Ranking): These platforms feature built-in AI search visibility checkers to map brand and domain mentions across ChatGPT, Copilot, Grok, and Google AI Overviews.
How to Improve AI Recommendations (GEO)
Most users on Quora agree that traditional SEO is only half the battle; AI engines synthesize direct conversational answers rather than listing web blue links. To get recommended: Quora +1
Build a Knowledge Graph: Implement JSON-LD schema markup on your website to clearly define your business type, services, hours, and physical location. eSEOspace
Optimize Off-Site Signals: AI engines heavily weigh third-party consensus. Ensure you have active, positive profiles and reviews on platforms AI trusts, such as Reddit, G2, LinkedIn, Yelp, and YouTube. Instagram·Neil Patel +1
Direct Self-Testing: Manually ask ChatGPT customer-intent questions (e.g., "What is the best [your service] in [your city]?") to audit your real-time standing. BaaDigi +1
If you'd like, share your industry and city, and I can help you figure out which prompts customers are using to search for your services on AI engines.
